subject: Sentinel Health MAP: performance vetting & close timeline
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gutiérrez <elena.gutierrez@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sentinel Health MAP: performance vetting & close timeline

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. Attached is the latest mutual action plan (MAP) with the performance validation section expanded (Sentinel_MAP_v3.pdf). To keep the procurement and legal cadence intact, we'd like to finalize the performance verification step this week and lock the close timeline in the MAP. Proposed high-level asks: 

- Redwood runs an end-to-end performance validation against your test harness (see details below).
- Focus: TTFT (time-to-first-token) for chat streaming + streaming per-token latency, and concurrency sweep to validate sustained throughput. We will report p50/p95/p99 for TTFT and per-token streaming latency, and overall tokens/sec.
- Targets (for planning/discussion):
  • Concurrency target: 120 concurrent user sessions
  • Throughput objective: sustain >= 6k tokens/sec at that concurrency with the recommended model variant
  • TTFT goal (baseline): p50 <= 120 ms, p95 <= 400 ms, p99 <= 1.2 s (we'll measure actuals)

If that aligns, we propose a single benchmark window on Saturday 2027-04-03 (UTC-friendly window) with two runs: baseline (no quant) and optimized (int8/quantized + batch tuning). Deliverables from Redwood: raw CSV of run traces (bench-run-20270403.csv), a one-page summary with p50/p95/p99 and throughput (redwood-bench-summary.txt), and recommendations for runtime config.

High-level timeline we want in the MAP:
- Performance run + results: by EOD Sun 2027-04-03
- Procurement completes & signature: by Fri 2027-04-10
- Staging rollout: Apr 18–20
- Prod rollout: target week of Apr 25

Please confirm test harness access details and any constraints (rate limits, IP allowlist, or sample prompt corpus you want us to use).

Attachments: [Attachment: Sentinel_MAP_v3.pdf (PDF, 214 KB)]

Thanks,

--
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0184

Aditya—

Appreciate the concrete plan. We can support the Saturday window. A few notes from our side: 

- Test harness: we'll provide a harness that drives 1–200 concurrent simulated sessions; see attached spec (sentinel_test_harness_spec.xlsx). The harness runs representative chat prompts (mix of short & long contexts) and exposes per-request timestamps for TTFT and per-token streaming latencies.
- Environment: tests should run against our staging endpoint (staging.sentinelhealth.com) from Redwood's dedicated capacity; we'll provide IPs for allowlist and a staging API key.
- Please include two prompt sets: clinical triage (short prompts) and clinician summary (longer context).
- We are particularly interested in p95/p99 tail for TTFT when concurrency spikes.

If you can send a short test run plan (times, exact concurrency sweep steps) we'll confirm the allowlist and provide the API key via secure link.

Attachments: [Attachment: sentinel_test_harness_spec.xlsx (XLSX, 48 KB)]

Best,
Elena Gutiérrez
Director, Platform Engineering
Sentinel Health

Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sentinel Health MAP: performance vetting & close timeline

Elena, Aditya —

Thanks — below is the Redwood bench plan and the exact sweep we'll run on Sat 2027-04-03 (UTC):

Bench plan (high level)
1) Warmup: 15 min steady-state at 20% target concurrency to populate KV cache.
2) Baseline run (no quant): concurrency sweep 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 80, 120, 160, 200; 2-minute sample at each point; collect TTFT (first token timestamp) and per-token streaming latency traces; capture tokens/sec.
3) Optimization run (int8 + session-level batching + prefix-cache enabled): same sweep.
4) Repeat clinician-summary prompt set once more at 120 concurrency for 10 minutes to capture tail behavior.

Metrics captured:
- TTFT: p50/p95/p99 (ms)
- Streaming per-token latency: p50/p95/p99 (ms)
- Tokens/sec sustained at each concurrency
- Error rate (5xx/timeout counts)

Deliverables (within 24 hours):
- bench-run-20270403.csv (raw traces per request/token)
- redwood-bench-summary.txt (one-page p50/p95/p99 + config used + quick recommendations)

We will run the jobs from Redwood Dedicated region-us-west-2 and upload artifacts to the shared Drive link after the run. Our engineer on the run will be on-call in the channel if we see timeouts.

Attachment stubs: [Attachment: bench-run-20270403.csv (CSV, 2.1 MB)] [Attachment: redwood-bench-summary.txt (TXT, 6 KB)]

Proposed run window (UTC-friendly): 2027-04-03 02:00–06:00 UTC (that covers your business hours) — confirm and we'll ask for the allowlist and API key.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Sentinel Health MAP: performance vetting & close timeline

Elena / team —

We completed the benchmark window and uploaded artifacts to the shared Drive link. Executive summary below (baseline vs optimized). Full CSV and a concise summary attached.

Quick results (clinician-summary prompt set, 120 concurrent sessions sustained):
- Baseline (no quant):
  • TTFT p50 = 240 ms; p95 = 860 ms; p99 = 1.9 s
  • Streaming per-token latency p50 = 22 ms; p95 = 78 ms; p99 = 210 ms
  • Sustained tokens/sec ≈ 5,900 (mean)
  • Error rate: 0.6% (timeouts during the 160–200 spike only)
- Optimized (int8 + batch tuning + prefix-cache):
  • TTFT p50 = 110 ms; p95 = 380 ms; p99 = 1.05 s
  • Streaming per-token latency p50 = 16 ms; p95 = 42 ms; p99 = 115 ms
  • Sustained tokens/sec ≈ 7,200 (mean)
  • Error rate: 0.1%

Interpretation and recommendation:
- The optimized configuration meets your throughput objective (>= 6k tokens/sec) at 120 concurrent sessions and materially reduces TTFT and token latency tails.
- We recommend you adopt the optimized runtime settings in staging (int8 quant + session-level batching + prefix-cache) and we can provide a config snippet to include in your deployment.

Next steps (as updated in the MAP):
- Redwood to provide the one-page summary + config snippet: done (redwood-bench-summary.txt attached).
- Sentinel to sign procurement by 2027-04-10 to reserve the Dedicated capacity profile (per deal DEAL-9392).
- Staging rollout: Apr 18–20; Redwood will be on standby for the first 48 hours.

Attachments: [Attachment: bench-run-20270403.csv (CSV, 2.1 MB)] [Attachment: redwood-bench-summary.txt (TXT, 6 KB)]
Appreciate the fast turnaround — we'll update the MAP with the test results and push an updated version to the Drive link.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
